brand.mission: Every student in the Rio Grande Valley deserves a clear path — to a career, to college, or to the next level of the game. See all three. Choose yours.

roles.label: Demo
roles.shellNote: Role home — full content arrives in the next build step.

pathways.careerDesc: Certificates and licenses. Fast training, fast paychecks — no college degree needed.
pathways.collegeDesc: US and international options, with scholarships matched to you.
pathways.sportsDesc: Your recruiting profile for college programs and pro clubs — with Racing 360 reports in one place.
pathways.combineNote: You can combine pathways — for example, earn a certificate now, keep playing, and apply to college later.

login.subtitle: One account. Three pathways.

signup.title: Create a parent account
signup.subtitle: First your account, then add your children.
signup.name: Full name
signup.under13Note: Under 13? By law, a parent creates and owns the account. You'll manage privacy settings together.
signup.created: Account created (demo). You can sign in now.

onboarding.title: A few quick questions
onboarding.under13Note: A parent creates and owns this account. You'll explore together in Explorer mode.
onboarding.teenNote: A parent or guardian must approve before anything is shared outside the app.
onboarding.adultNote: You control your own privacy settings.
onboarding.compassTeaser: Next: the Pathway Compass — about 3 minutes, and you can skip any question.

consent.title: Consent Center
consent.subtitle: You decide what's shared, with whom. Everything starts off.
consent.grades: Share my grades for scholarship matching
consent.gradesDesc: Lets the app match scholarships to your grades.
consent.colleges: Share my sports profile with college coaches
consent.collegesDesc: College programs can find your athletic profile.
consent.proClubs: Share my sports profile with professional clubs
consent.proClubsDesc: Pro club scouts (including partners like Racing de Santander) can find your profile.
consent.videosDesc: Approved viewers can watch your highlights.
consent.partnerContactDesc: Employers and training schools can send a request. A parent approves it if you're under 18.
consent.noAccess: Nobody outside TX Futures Alliance can see your information.
consent.neverShared: Never shared: your home address, school ID, family income, or contact details. Contact always goes through an in-app request a parent approves first.
consent.minorNote: For students under 18, a parent or guardian also sees this page and must approve sharing.
consent.clubDev: Use my player data for club player development
consent.clubDevDesc: FC Brownsville coaches can follow development over time (Racing 360 reports, evaluations, minutes, attendance). Never visible to scouts, partners or the public. No data from social media or outside sources.
consent.clubDevParentNote: Ask a parent or guardian to turn this on for you — they manage this switch until you turn 18.

privacy.title: Privacy, in plain words
privacy.p1: Your information belongs to you. We collect only what helps you plan your future: your profile, your grades if you share them, your soccer profile, and your goals.
privacy.p2: Everything starts private. Nothing is shared with colleges, clubs, or employers unless you (and your parent, if you're under 18) turn it on in the Consent Center.
privacy.p3: You can turn sharing off at any time. You can ask us to delete your information.
privacy.p4: We never sell your information. Ever.

admin.resetDone: Demo data reset to the original 182 sample students.
admin.forceErrorsHint: Makes every request fail, to test error states.

home.shellHint: Dashboard content (plan timeline, deadlines, messages) arrives in the next build step.

compass.title: Pathway Compass
compass.subtitle: About 3 minutes. One question at a time — skip any of them.
compass.q2Title: How soon do you or your family need you earning money?

compass.openRgv: Staying in the Rio Grande Valley

results.title: Your three pathways
results.subtitle: Based on your answers. You can walk more than one path — most students do.
results.urgentNote: Shown first because you said you need income soon. That's a real plan — and it doesn't close any doors.
results.whyIncome: you said you need income soon

results.combinedTitle: A combined plan could look like this

profile.documentsHint: Report cards, certificates you've earned, awards. Files stay on your device in this demo — we save the name only.

collegePage.eligNote: Labels: NCAA/NAIA rules change. Verify each item with the official eligibility center.
collegePage.elig1: Register with the NCAA Eligibility Center (D1/D2) — rules to verify
collegePage.elig2: Register with PlayNAIA (NAIA schools) — rules to verify
collegePage.elig3: Complete the required core courses (16 for NCAA D1) — rules to verify
collegePage.elig4: Keep core-course GPA at or above the requirement — rules to verify
collegePage.elig5: Send final transcript after graduation — rules to verify
collegePage.elig6: For JUCO (NJCAA): confirm eligibility with the college directly — rules to verify
collegePage.aidParentOnly: For parents/guardians only. Optional. Nothing you enter here is stored — this is a demo of the form.
collegePage.aidFafsa: FAFSA is the federal application for student aid. It unlocks Pell Grants (money you don't repay), work-study and federal loans. Free to file.
collegePage.aidTasfa: TASFA is the Texas application for students who can't file FAFSA (for example, undocumented students). It opens state and campus aid in Texas.
collegePage.aidDoc3: W-2 forms and records of other income
collegePage.aidDoc4: Bank statements and records of investments
collegePage.aidDl1: FAFSA opens — usually October 1 for the next school year
collegePage.aidDl2: Texas priority deadline — usually January 15 (verify each year)
collegePage.aidDl3: College deadlines — each campus sets its own; check early
collegePage.aidNoIncome: We never ask for or store your exact income in this app. FAFSA/TASFA are filed on the official government sites — we only help you prepare.
collegePage.aidChecklistNote: Checking items here is just for your view — it is not saved.
collegePage.explorerNote: College exploration opens fully at 13. For now: peek at where people study after school.

sportsPage.title: Sports Career
sportsPage.subtitle: Your recruiting profile, videos, progress and opportunities — all in one place.

sportsPage.noAchievements: No achievements yet — your coach can help you add them.

sportsPage.scoutPreviewHidden: Right now scouts can't see you at all. Turn on sharing in the Consent Center when you're ready.
sportsPage.scoutPreviewNote: This is exactly what an approved scout sees — no contact info, ever. Contact requests come to you (and your parent if you're under 18) for approval.

talentPage.title: Talent Insights
talentPage.subtitle: FC Brownsville player development — find and grow players whose potential is being overlooked.
talentPage.clubOnly: Club staff only — never shown to players, parents, partners or scouts
talentPage.lockedBody: Talent Insights is only available to FC Brownsville club staff. Nothing here is visible to players, parents, partners or scouts.
talentPage.boardHint: The same standardized measures over time. Headline: improvement rate next to current level. Tap a player for their timeline.
talentPage.consentOff: {count} club players have not turned on the player-development consent and are not shown
talentPage.q1Hint: Born January–March — oldest in the age group
talentPage.q4Hint: Born October–December — youngest in the age group
talentPage.timelineHint: standardized measures (1–10) from Racing 360, coach evaluations and physical tests
talentPage.compareHint: Players are only compared within their own birth year. Late-born players are often physically behind — and overlooked.
talentPage.adjustedNote: Age adjustment is a heuristic (+0.25 per later birth quarter) — calibrate it with your own data. Decision support, not a ranking.
talentPage.gemsHint: High improvement rate + strong technical/tactical ratings + low minutes or a lower team level. Each suggestion says WHY.
talentPage.tryoutsHint: Fixed rubric, at least 2 evaluators per player. Big disagreements are flagged for a second look.

technical.1: loses the ball under no pressure
technical.2: controls and passes with strong foot only
technical.3: reliable first touch and passing both feet

tactical.1: chases the ball, out of position
tactical.5: reads the game two plays ahead

physical.2: keeps up in short bursts only
physical.4: wins most duels and repeated sprints

mentality.4: asks for feedback, competes every drill
mentality.5: lifts the whole group, leads by example

talentPage.evalHint: Score 1–5 per dimension using the rubric anchors.
talentPage.positionsHint: Define what matters for each position and see who fits — including players currently playing somewhere else.
talentPage.profileHint: Pick the attributes that matter for this position and how much (0 = ignore, 5 = critical).
talentPage.fairnessHint: Who gets selected for top teams — by birth quarter, girls/boys and ZIP code. If selection is skewed, it shows up here.
talentPage.selectedDef: “Selected” means placed on an Academy team (sample data).
talentPage.auditHint: Every Talent Insights view — who looked at which player, when. Newest first.
